scenarios.title: A｜告诉朋友
scenarios.setting: 玩家最近刚决定搬家，聊天时告诉朋友。

turns.text: So, anything new with you lately?

turns.prompt: 你想向朋友分享即将搬家的消息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Actually, yeah. I’m moving next month.

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, yeah. I’m moving next month.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I finally found a new place, so I’ll be moving soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: I finally found a new place, so I’ll be moving soon.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Big news—I’m moving out of my current apartment.

feedback.naturalExpression: Big news—I’m moving out of my current apartment.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I’m actually moving to a new neighborhood in a few weeks.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m actually moving to a new neighborhood in a few weeks.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: I will move my house next month.

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, yeah. I’m moving next month.
feedback.explanation: “move my house”可能像搬动整栋房子；搬家说“I’m moving”或“moving to a new place”。

turns.text: Really? I had no idea! Why are you moving?

turns.prompt: 关于「搬家」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I wanted somewhere a little closer to work.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted somewhere a little closer to work.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: My lease is ending, so I figured it was a good time to move.

feedback.naturalExpression: My lease is ending, so I figured it was a good time to move.
feedback.explanation: “lease”指租约，通常涉及租住期限和合同条件。

choices.text: I need a little more space. My current place is tiny.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need a little more space. My current place is tiny.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Honestly, I just wanted a change.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I just wanted a change.
feedback.explanation: “wanted a change”表示想换个环境，是解释搬家等决定的简洁说法。

turns.prompt: 你想告诉对方计划搬家的时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: The first weekend of next month.

feedback.naturalExpression: The first weekend of next month.
feedback.explanation: 用下个月第一个周末定位时间，适合日期尚未细化的计划。

choices.text: I get the keys on Friday, and I’m moving in on Saturday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I get the keys on Friday, and I’m moving in on Saturday.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Hopefully next weekend, if everything goes according to plan.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hopefully next weekend, if everything goes according to plan.
feedback.explanation: “according to”引出信息来源，让对方知道判断依据是记录、通知还是其他说明。

scenarios.title: B｜聊新住处
scenarios.setting: 在“搬家”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“聊新住处”。

turns.text: So what’s the new place like?

turns.prompt: 你想说明或核对地址，方便对方找到位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a little bigger than my current apartment.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a little bigger than my current apartment.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: It’s got a lot more natural light, which I love.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s got a lot more natural light, which I love.
feedback.explanation: “natural light”指自然采光，描述房屋时与灯光照明不同。

choices.text: The apartment itself is pretty small, but the neighborhood is great.

feedback.naturalExpression: The apartment itself is pretty small, but the neighborhood is great.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: It’s nothing fancy, but it feels really cozy.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s nothing fancy, but it feels really cozy.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: It has two rooms and one living room.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a little bigger than my current apartment.
feedback.explanation: “two rooms”不确定是否包含客厅；住宅介绍中说“two bedrooms and a living room”更准确。

turns.text: Nice! Is it far from here?

turns.prompt: 关于「搬家」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Not really. It’s only about twenty minutes away.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not really. It’s only about twenty minutes away.
feedback.explanation: “not really”是较温和的否定，常表示不太符合或并不怎么做。

choices.text: It’s on the other side of town, so it’s a bit farther.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s on the other side of town, so it’s a bit farther.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: It’s actually much closer to the city center.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s actually much closer to the city center.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: It’s right near a subway station, which is really convenient.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s right near a subway station, which is really convenient.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

turns.prompt: 你想表达对新住处的期待，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I’m pretty excited about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m pretty excited about it.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I think so too. I just hope the move isn’t too stressful.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think so too. I just hope the move isn’t too stressful.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Definitely. I can’t wait to get settled in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Definitely. I can’t wait to get settled in.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

scenarios.title: C｜邀请别人来家里
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经搬进新家一段时间。

turns.prompt: 你想邀请朋友来新家做客，会怎么说？

choices.text: You should come over sometime and see the new place.

feedback.naturalExpression: You should come over sometime and see the new place.
feedback.explanation: “come over”邀请对方来家里，“sometime”表示具体时间可以再商量。

choices.text: Once I’m fully unpacked, you should come over.

feedback.naturalExpression: Once I’m fully unpacked, you should come over.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I’m having a few people over next Saturday. Want to come?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m having a few people over next Saturday. Want to come?
feedback.explanation: “I’m having”描述当前正在经历的情况，适合交代此刻的问题或安排。

choices.text: You haven’t seen my new place yet. You should come by!

feedback.naturalExpression: You haven’t seen my new place yet. You should come by!
feedback.explanation: “haven’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: You can come to my home someday.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: You should come over sometime and see the new place.
feedback.explanation: “come to my home”可以理解；邀请朋友到家中常说“come over”，语气更轻松。

turns.text: I’d love to! Are you free this weekend?

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Saturday afternoon would be perfect.

feedback.naturalExpression: Saturday afternoon would be perfect.
feedback.explanation: “would be perfect”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Yeah! How does Sunday sound?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah! How does Sunday sound?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: I’m free Saturday after three. Come over whenever.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m free Saturday after three. Come over whenever.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Sure. I’ll send you my new address.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll send you my new address.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.prompt: 你想回应朋友是否需要带东西的询问，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, just bring yourself.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, just bring yourself.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Nope! I’ve got everything covered.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nope! I’ve got everything covered.
feedback.explanation: “got everything covered”表示事情都已安排妥当，让对方知道目前无需再帮忙。

choices.text: You don’t need to, but feel free to bring something to drink.

feedback.naturalExpression: You don’t need to, but feel free to bring something to drink.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。
